about: Shared vectors of nenrin-verify furui-day and resume-admission. Python, JavaScript, Go and Java run this file and must give the same expect. The keys document in each world lists a test key as runner-1; no production key or record is used, except the real OpenTimestamps proof of ledger entry 80 for the parser.

cases.name: day ok, leaf 0 (the heartbeat) of 5
day ok, leaf 3 of 5
day ok, leaf 4 of 5 (the last leaf)
day ok, a day of one leaf (empty audit path)
day ok, leaf 5 of 7 (decision null, rules and scope null)
day ok, leaf 2 of 7 (stop, off_topic)
not_yet 1: the day is still open (404 day_open)
fail 1: the day closed with no check (status empty), so there is no leaf
not_yet 6: the day record waits for the ledger's batch (pending_anchor)
not_yet 6: in a batch, the batch's OpenTimestamps proof not yet in Bitcoin
